later_summary_dataset: 2026-10-09 four-policy summary; S1/R1 raw trajectories unavailable locally
source_score_formula: Internal Q3 = sum_s weight*survival*exp(-sqrt((MSEvx+MSEvy+MSEyaw)/3)); not official scenario formula
official_formula_known: Simulation score is sum of seven scenario points/max70; official mapping from physical errors is not known

protocol.validity: aliveaftercurrentstep; firstterminationtick and later resettrajectory excluded; no timeout allowed inside horizon
protocol.ordinary_definition: outsideinitial,truecommandchangeprefixesandpostpushprefixes; G4/G5/G6 identical5scommands are not command transitions

C0_5500.no_fall_counterfactual_definition: Only change survival multiplier; recorded tracking held fixed, not a new policy result

F10_3000.no_fall_counterfactual_definition: Only change survival multiplier; recorded tracking held fixed, not a new policy result

S1_tracking_pair.no_fall_counterfactual_definition: Only change survival multiplier; recorded tracking held fixed, not a new policy result

F10_changed_error_counterfactuals.interpretation: Changed-error algebra only. No feasible policy forecast, no official score conversion; zeroing a phase is an unattainability-agnostic sensitivity bound.

historical_official_headroom.interpretation: Historical score-deficit arithmetic upperbound only; not a candidate score forecast

design_interpretation.AX_linear2p25_yaw1p25: Information-seeking axis tradeoff experiment, not a supported score-leading candidate. F10 yaw improves all seven scenarios and is still 41.49% of proxy mixed MSE; lowering its reward could surrender the observed gain.
design_interpretation.response_and_tail: Prioritize full-window response/tail metrics alongside means; first/true-change/post-push windows are distinct and not repeated identical command boundaries.
design_interpretation.ordinary_yaw: Preserve the demonstrated yaw gain while investigating ordinary-window bias/dispersion. Ordinary samples contribute 86.73% of remaining F10 yaw SSE.
design_interpretation.B2: Preserving F10 tracking while changing B1 cost terms avoids an unvalidated axis tradeoff, but there is no B1/B2 closed-loop rollout here and no measured advantage is claimed.

limitations: One training seed and unequal training lengths; no causal weight-effect estimate
Tail/phase analyses describe C0/F10 recordedbehavior only; no S1/R1tail or B1 performance invented
Initial/transition/pushMSE is not wholly removable; no dynamic lowerbound estimated
Mixed-axis proxy combinesm/sandrad/s; axisfractionsareproxy-specific, not official weights
All diagnostic windows retain full-window score; no transient deletion is used for ranking
